figures.caption: Tē 36 tô:—Leng-khí tò-pêng ê chhùi-khí : A, tē it mñg-khí ; B, tē jī mñg-khí ; CH, káu-khí; CHH, tē it sió-khū-khí; E, tē jī sió-khū-khí. Chiah ê sò·-jī ê hō-thâu sī chí sím-mih géh hoat-chhut. (From Gray's “Anatomy,” by permission of Longmans, Green and Co., publishers.)

Tē 37 tô:—Chiàⁿ-pêng kú-sèng-khí ê khí-lia̍t, tùi gōa-bīn khòaⁿ-ê : 1, tē saⁿ tōa-khū-khí (tì-khí) ; 2, 3, tē jī kap tē it tōa-khū-khí ; 4, 5, tē jī kap tē it sió-khū-khí ; 6, káu-khí ; 7, 8, tē jī kap tē it mñg-khí (Cunningham).
